validation.probeScope: The fixture injects a blocked filesystem probe and missing, permission-denied, directory and restored regular-file results. Ordinary completed-file cases also use the default Windows filesystem status lookup.
validation.fixtureCorrection: The first run selected the disabled Properties parent while the nested Audio Metadata dialog was open. The observer now skips disabled parent windows. The complete rerun passed.
validation.visualReview: The 96 DPI render retains the reference layout, Windows type label, file icon and readable controls.
validation.timingScope: Responsiveness was checked with controlled blocked probes. Fresh paired IDM timing was not collected.
